description: Required topics for WPL17 (CAN-B, X1.2, 50 kbps). VERIFIED on real hardware (ICS classic). Mirrors the members used by signal_requests_wpl17.h: KESSEL_CANB (0x201) for the DHW/room/heating-curve setpoints, KESSEL (0x180) for AUSSENTEMP/pump status, MANAGER (0x480) for the operating mode, HEIZMODUL (0x500) for flow/return/compressor, HEIZMODUL_WPL (0x514) for the daily energy counters. RAUMSOLLTEMP_II/III are absent (single heating circuit).
